offering_description.value: Provides healthcare experience measurement software, surveys and benchmarking data to hospitals, health systems and physician practices. Clients use it to measure patient and employee experience and to act on the results, delivered mainly as subscription software with consulting support.

primary_products.value: patient experience survey software; employee engagement survey platform; benchmarking databases

primary_services.value: survey administration; data analytics; consulting; performance improvement advisory

customer_segment.value: B2B: hospitals, health systems, physician practices, ambulatory and senior care providers

revenue_model.value: subscription: annual software and survey subscriptions paid by healthcare providers; service fees: consulting, survey administration and analytics engagements

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: hosts survey and analytics platform, takes in patient and employee survey responses, sells to providers; service provider: runs survey programs and advisory work for health system clients

geography_served.value: US national: Clients across the United States, with most customers being US hospitals and health systems

specialization.value: niche specialist: healthcare experience measurement surveys, analytics and benchmarking

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: in-house sales teams selling directly to hospitals and health systems

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: handles patient survey data subject to HIPAA privacy rules

notes: Company size category is a judgment call based on scale within healthcare survey vendors.
